task_completion.description: Create a survey with the specific title 'Riverside County Community Needs Assessment 2024'.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Screenshot of the LimeSurvey 'Survey summary' or 'Edit survey settings' page showing the title field matches exactly.

task_completion.description: Configure welcome message with 'Riverside County' and 'voluntary', and end message with 'thank' and ('resource' or 'support').
task_completion.visual_evidence: Screenshots of the 'Text elements' tab showing the Welcome and End message text fields with the required keywords.

task_completion.description: Set format to 'Group by group', enable progress bar, and enable back button.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Screenshot of the 'Presentation' settings tab showing 'Format' set to 'Group by group' and 'Show progress bar' and 'Show back button' toggled to 'On'.

task_completion.description: Enable date stamping, disable IP logging/referrer URL, and set admin email to 'dr.martinez@riverside-sociology.edu'.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Screenshots of 'Publication & access' or 'Notification & data' settings showing Date stamp 'On', IP/Referrer 'Off', and the specific admin email address in the notification field.

task_completion.description: Set End URL to 'https://www.riversidecounty.gov/community-resources' and create at least two question groups with one question each.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Screenshot of 'Text elements' showing the End URL and the 'Survey structure' side-bar showing at least two distinct groups, each containing at least one question.

task_completion.description: Activate the survey so it is live.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Screenshot showing the 'Activate survey' button has been clicked, or a green status indicator/message saying 'This survey is now active'.

integrity.description: The agent used the LimeSurvey web interface rather than manipulating a database or config file via terminal.

integrity.description: The agent actually typed or pasted the specific required strings rather than leaving default 'Lorem Ipsum' text.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots of the text editors for Welcome/End messages showing the specific required keywords instead of default LimeSurvey text.

integrity.description: The agent logged in using the provided credentials.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The survey title must be exactly 'Riverside County Community Needs Assessment 2024'. Note that the required End URL 'https://www.riversidecounty.gov/community-resources' and the admin email 'dr.martinez@riverside-sociology.edu' are part of the task requirements even though the domain names are fictional/non-functional in the real world; the agent must use these exact strings as specified in the instructions.
